title.en: Grammar: Where the hard consonant doubles (வல்லினம் மிகும் இடங்கள்)

text.en: Sometimes a hard consonant doubles when two words join, as when 'the bird' + 'song' becomes 'bird-song' with an extra sound.

In Tamil, when a word ends in certain sounds, the next word's first hard consonant (க, ச, த, ப) doubles. This is called வல்லினம் மிகுதல். It occurs after words such as அந்த, இந்த, எந்த and after certain suffixes.
For example அந்த + பையன் becomes அந்தப் பையன், and the second case ending ஐ is followed by a doubled consonant, as in மரத்தைப் பார். Also with போன்ற words like இரண்டாம் வேற்றுமை.
Memorise the rules with examples and practise writing sentences. The textbook gives such places as: after அ, இ, உ-type demonstrative words, after the accusative ஐ and after verbal participles ending in ஆ.
